properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 stream implementations) is pulled in transitively by elliptic via the crypto-browserify polyfill chain that the wallet-connector packages in @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets require. Shipped in node_modules; no first-party call site in src/ — presence is what this inventory records. Changeable by pruning unused wallet adapters.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@4.1.1 is required by @particle-network/auth@0.5.6 (Particle wallet connector, bundled via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets@0.19.16). crypto-js ships SHA-1 among its primitives; no first-party call site — the app instantiates only UnsafeBurnerWalletAdapter. Changeable by pruning the adapter bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/secp256k1 is required by @solana/web3.js@1.73.0 (support for Solana's on-chain secp256k1 instruction/verification program) and by @scure/bip32@1.1.5 (BIP32 HD derivation in wallet connectors). secp256k1 ECDSA is classical, Shor-vulnerable; the curve is protocol-fixed (Solana syscall + Bitcoin-style wallets), replaceable only at protocol/vendor level — the app's control is which adapters to bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey@1.0.x is OpenSSL's legacy EVP_BytesToKey password-to-key KDF (single-round MD5 unless overridden). It ships as part of the crypto-browserify browser cipher shim (browserify-aes, browserify-cipher) and parse-asn1, all installed via the wallet dependency stack that Next.js browserifies. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/poly1305 and @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 are required by @walletconnect/utils@2.5.2 (WalletConnect session encryption, bundled via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets). Poly1305 here is the MAC half of the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD; no first-party call site. Same logical construct as ALG-3d4cff53 (ChaCha20-Poly1305).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is THE Solana signature scheme (transaction and message signing) — the app's core classical dependency. @noble/ed25519 is a DIRECT dependency (package.json:15), required also by @solana/web3.js@1.73.0; @stablelib/ed25519 is required by @walletconnect/relay-auth@1.0.4. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh@4.0.0 (browserify ECDH polyfill over elliptic) is part of the crypto-browserify chain pulled in by the wallet-connector packages via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets. No first-party ECDH call site in src/; the app performs no standalone key agreement. Classical ECDH is Shor-vulnerable; control point is pruning the adapter bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/x25519 is required by @walletconnect/utils@2.5.2 — WalletConnect's session key agreement (X25519 + HKDF, encrypted with ChaCha20-Poly1305), bundled via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets. Harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to captured session traffic; no first-party call site. Migration to ML-KEM-768 happens in the WalletConnect SDK, not here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: keccak@3.0.3 is the SHA-3/Keccak implementation used by the Torus wallet stack (@toruslabs/broadcast-channel, @toruslabs/metadata-helpers, @toruslabs/openlogin-utils), which ships via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets. SHA-3 is quantum-safe (Grover gives only square-root speedup), so posture is fine; recorded here because the algorithm ships in the build. No app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: pbkdf2@3.1.2 (the browserify-compat PBKDF2) is part of the crypto-browserify Node-crypto shim that Next.js bundles for browser builds, and of parse-asn1. Iteration count is chosen by the caller, so no weak-parameter finding applies here — the library capability ships. No app call site in src/.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/hkdf@1.0.1 is RFC 5869 HKDF (SHA-256), required by @walletconnect/utils — WalletConnect v1's relay key-derivation — shipped via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets. HKDF is quantum-safe. No app call site in src/.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@4.1.1 provides the AES implementation here; required by @particle-network/auth@0.5.6 (Particle wallet connector bundled via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets). Symmetric AE — Grover only halves key strength, so A- posture; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.2.0 is required by @solana/web3.js@1.73.0 (blockhash/signature hashing) and @scure/bip32; ships SHA-256 among many digests. Solid classical hash — Grover only square-roots preimage cost; no urgent action. No first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 is required by @walletconnect/utils@2.5.2 — the AEAD protecting WalletConnect session traffic, bundled via @solana/wallet-adapter-wallets. Symmetric AEAD, quantum-resistant (A+ posture); no first-party call site. The same construct powers the Poly1305 object ALG-e6238d01.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: sha.js@2.4.11 provides streamed SHA-1/SHA-2 for the browserify crypto polyfill chain (hash.js/sha.js under crypto-browserify), pulled in by the wallet-connector packages. No first-party call site; shipped in node_modules. Same SHA-1/SHA-2 surface as ALG-50e53f84 (hash.js).
